blocker.why: ApprovalDecision.validate() requires authorization_scope whenever the paper gate subject is the actor or owner. Governance stamps the scope only in the persona-lifecycle branch of _approval_command (main.py, 'if is_persona_lifecycle_decision(current)'). A research-owned card decision takes the 'else' branch, which cannot stamp it, so the real gate gets HTTP 400 'authorization_scope is required whenever the dedicated dev paper subject is the actor or owner of a decision'. paper_approval_scope.py cannot stamp it: require_paper_owned_decision receives decision.to_dict(), a copy.
